Factual corrections and public-removal requests are free. No membership or payment is required.

What happens if a profile is removed

Removal requests are reviewed before public visibility changes. When a removal is approved, the profile no longer appears publicly. Franklin Navigator may keep a limited internal suppression record so a routine data update does not republish it by accident.
